candidates.fit: Only JLC Basic 3.3V/>=300mA LDO found; SOT-223 tab gives 45-90 C/W theta-JA (copper-dependent) - the only candidate that clears the 0.51W worst case with real margin at 40C ambient (Tj ~68-86C); tradeoffs are 1.1-1.3V dropout, 5-11mA Iq, and a datasheet-mandated >=22uF TANTALUM output cap (ceramic not endorsed).

Modern low-Iq (55uA typ) / low-dropout (125mV@300mA, 250mV@600mA) alternative, ceramic-stable 1.0uF X5R/X7R in+out, deep Extended stock; but package theta-JA(no heatsink)=184C/W puts Tj~134C at 40C ambient/0.51W worst case - thin margin to the 150C abs max, no exposed pad to improve it. Extended part (JLC setup fee applies).

Cheapest low-Iq (60uA typ) option with the deepest stock of any candidate, 1uF ceramic in/out; but the MSK-Semi 2nd-source datasheet's own SOT-23-5L package rating is Pd=300mW, already below the 510mW worst case, and it only characterizes dropout up to 200mA (500mA max-current claim unverified past that point) - verify against the original Richtek RT9013 datasheet at P3.

TI-branded, best-documented low-Iq (35uA typ) part with an explicit <=200mOhm output-ESR spec and 1uF X5R/X7R caps; but its 300mA current limit sits exactly at the requirement floor with zero headroom, and TI's own dissipation-vs-ambient table (500mW@25C, ~425mW interpolated @40C) is already below the 510mW worst case. Lowest stock and highest unit price of the four.
